cross_surface_findings: Official report indexes cover many more issuer-year rows than the observed price inventory, but code-set overlap is not historical population proof.

The official issued-history route demonstrates that the queried code universe materially changes visible lifecycle events: the 1,009-code financial union had no explicit Delisting rows in the bounded result, while adding 34 price-only codes surfaced 23 Delisting rows, including CNTX.

Current official raw surfaces are useful for source discovery and structural audits, but none supplies the combined daily PIT membership, issuer/ISIN continuity, publication/knowledge time, revision, and corporate-action effective-basis contract required for predictive admission.

The official report File_Modified, ratio fsDate, trading row date, event date, profile listing date, and current-directory listing date are distinct fields; none may be silently promoted into historical available-at authority.

The current profile-detail route improves present-day code/name/listing/status cross-checks but exposes no stock-ISIN field in the profile objects; nested bond ISINs do not repair stock issuer/security continuity.
